findings.summary: FlagBase.PostParse calls f.Set directly, bypassing Command.set/Set so setMultiValueParsingConfig never runs; env-var and file sources ignore custom slice/map separators and DisableSliceFlagSeparator, regressing slice flags and breaking the new map feature.

Separator settings are read only from the cmd calling set (command.go:356, 448-456) instead of the global removed from command_setup.go:133-139, so subcommands and persistent flags parsed by a child no longer inherit the parent's separator settings; should fall back through the parent chain.
disableSliceFlagSeparator is now a const that is always false and only referenced by tests, making it dead code.
